verdict.rationale: Branching, filtering and merging parallel paths is a fair question for a visual workflow tool like n8n, but the pack never documents conditional branching (If/Switch), Filter, or Merge nodes. The only related items are generic visual-canvas claims and error workflows, which are adjacent features and not the requested branching-and-merge logic.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can branch a workflow with conditions, filters, and parallel paths that merge back together
